people.name: Samson
people.line: Israelite judge with great strength from God

translations.web: Samson said to them, “If you behave like this, surely I will take revenge on you, and after that I will cease.”
translations.bsb: And Samson told them, “Because you have done this, I will not rest until I have taken vengeance upon you.”
translations.kjv: And Samson said unto them, Though ye have done this, yet will I be avenged of you, and after that I will cease.
translations.asv: And Samson said unto them, If ye do after this manner, surely I will be avenged of you, and after that I will cease.
